verdict.rationale: The only evidence of ingesting anything beyond chat is the GitHub README line that Honcho stores "messages and events," which suggests non-transcript data can be written into memory. Nothing documents ingesting documents, JSON payloads or business data specifically; the "any entity" and "runs alongside your files" claims describe what Honcho models or sits next to, not an ingestion path. missing for 10: documented document/file ingestion, JSON or structured-data ingestion APIs, business-data import paths, detail on what "events" covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ingest documents, JSON, and business data into memory — not just chat transcripts

citations.quote: Store messages and events, let Honcho reason in the background
